race.title: Vietti Barolo Hurst Park Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: VANDERPOEL took his form up to a smart level when making a successful return over C&D 3 weeks ago and, with further improvement likely in his second season over fences, he is fancied to follow up. Shakeyatailfeather is feared most with conditions promising to suit, while Calico also gives Dan Skelton a strong hand. VANDERPOEL (IRE) SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE) CALICO (GER)
race.bettingForecast: Vanderpoel (6/4), Ryan's Rocket (11/2), Martator (6/1), Shakeyatailfeather (6/1), Calico (7/1), Sans Bruit (8/1), Gabriel's Getaway (12/1)
